verdicts.summary: The 5s bound applies only to the run-scope close. The mutex, onShutdown and restart-fiber interrupt steps before it stay unbounded. The note admits this, and finding 0 states it.

`start` holds the mutex across configResolve, fileSystem.exists and onPreflightFailed. `stop` takes the same mutex with no timeout before it reaches `closeRun`. A hang in any of those steps blocks the quit finalizer, so `markComplete` never runs. This is the hazard finding 0 reports. Whether configResolve really hangs in practice (WSL cold start) is not something I could read from the code.
